scan_findings.finding_description: Address Space Layout Randomisation is not configured to maximum security level
scan_findings.finding_explanation: ASLR randomises memory addresses to prevent exploitation. Level 2 provides full randomisation including heap and stack.
scan_findings.finding_impact: Without full ASLR, attackers can more easily exploit memory corruption vulnerabilities.

scan_findings.finding_description: Kernel pointers are visible to unprivileged users
scan_findings.finding_explanation: Hiding kernel pointers prevents information disclosure attacks.
scan_findings.finding_impact: Exposed kernel pointers aid in kernel exploitation.

scan_findings.finding_description: SSH configuration allows direct root login
scan_findings.finding_explanation: Disabling root SSH login forces users to authenticate as regular users first, providing better audit trails.
scan_findings.finding_impact: Direct root access increases risk of brute-force attacks and provides no audit trail.
finding_remediation_steps: Restart SSH service: sudo systemctl restart sshd

scan_findings.finding_explanation: An active firewall blocks unauthorised network access.
scan_findings.finding_impact: Without a firewall, all network services are exposed.
finding_remediation_steps: Configure default deny: sudo ufw default deny incoming
